newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares at highs, investors optimistic.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares at highs, investors optimistic.

text.p: Portuguese shares ended at highs as a mood of optimism swept the Lisbon market. Mobile phone operator Telecel hit an all-time high of 10,250 escudos. Analysts said it could hit 11,000 escudos by March. "The telecommunications sector has good prospects. Whoever wants to be in the Portuguese market must have a portfolio that includes telecommunications shares," said one operator. The renewed strength of European shares helped Portuguese stocks to reach new highs, dealers said. "Monday could be less liquid than today, as often happens in the hours before foreign (U.S.) investors come to the market. But the overall sentiment is favourable," said one operator.
